description: What the stdio suite of the MCP client manager must notice (lib/mcp/client-manager.mjs, lib/mcp/server-config.mjs, the Hub wiring): the environment, the list guards, the no-replay rule, the process tree, the protocol posture and the secrets.

mutations.name: C1-no-scrub
mutations.what: the child gets the Hub's whole environment

mutations.name: C2-repeated-cursor-accepted
mutations.what: a repeated cursor is followed

mutations.name: C3-page-cap-off-by-one
mutations.what: 1,001 pages are read

mutations.name: C4-duplicates-accepted
mutations.what: a list with a name twice is accepted

mutations.name: C5-empty-name-accepted
mutations.what: an empty name is accepted

mutations.name: C6-first-page-only
mutations.what: the next page is never asked for

mutations.name: C7-unknown-result-type-refused
mutations.what: an unknown resultType is left to the SDK, which refuses it

mutations.name: C8-direct-child-only
mutations.what: closing kills the direct child, not its tree (a .cmd or shell wrapper leaves the server running)

patches.old: if (running()) await stopOwned(child, { group: this.#group }).catch((error) => this.onerror?.(error));

mutations.name: C9-close-does-not-wait-for-exit
mutations.what: close() resolves without waiting for the child's exit. POSIX only: there stopOwned({group: true}) returns right after SIGKILL. On Windows it waits for taskkill /T /F to exit, which happens only after the tree is gone, so the child's exit is already seen and the mutant SURVIVED there (measured 2026-11-20); the explicit wait is kept so that close() never depends on that ordering

patches.old: const exited = await Promise.race([this.#exited.then(() => true), delay(EXIT_WAIT_MS).then(() => false)]);

mutations.name: C10-no-grace
mutations.what: the tree is stopped at once, without the grace period after the end of stdin

mutations.name: C11-log-unmasked
mutations.what: log lines (the server's stderr) are not masked

mutations.name: C12-no-connect-deadline
mutations.what: the connect deadline is 100 times later

patches.old: did not connect within ${limit} ms.`)), limit);
patches.new: did not connect within ${limit} ms.`)), limit * 100);

mutations.name: C13-no-legacy-restart
mutations.what: a server that dies on the version probe is not started again with the 2025 handshake

mutations.name: C14-capabilities-declared
mutations.what: the client declares roots and sampling

mutations.name: C15-auto-fulfil
mutations.what: input_required answers are fulfilled automatically
mutations.equivalent: No elicitation, sampling or roots handler is registered, so the SDK refuses to fulfil (CAPABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED) and sends nothing again; measured on 2026-11-20 against tests/fixtures/mcp-raw-server.mjs --mode input-required (one tools/call either way). autoFulfill: false keeps a call from being re-sent once a later slice registers a handler.

mutations.name: C16-replay-after-failure
mutations.what: a call that failed or timed out is sent once more

patches.old: return await connection.client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, { signal, timeout: limit, maxTotalTimeout: limit, resetTimeoutOnProgress: false, toolDefinition: tool });
patches.new: return await connection.client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, { signal, timeout: limit, maxTotalTimeout: limit, resetTimeoutOnProgress: false, toolDefinition: tool }).catch(() => connection.client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, { signal, timeout: limit, toolDefinition: tool }));

mutations.name: C17-secrets-not-registered
mutations.what: resolveForConnect does not register the secrets with the masker

patches.old: for (const value of secrets) if (value) this.registerSecret(value);

mutations.name: C18-public-view-leaks-blob
mutations.what: list() returns the protected form of a secret

mutations.name: C19-credentials-not-forced-secret
mutations.what: a credential-looking name is stored in plain text

patches.old: export const mustBeSecret = (kind, name, value) => (kind === 'env' ? SECRET_ENV_NAME.test(name) : isCredentialHeader(name)) || hasUrlPassword(value);

mutations.name: C20-undeclared-variable
mutations.what: ${NAME} of a variable the env map does not declare is accepted

mutations.name: C21-reserved-id
mutations.what: the ids local and studio are accepted

mutations.name: C22-sse-not-named
mutations.what: the legacy SSE transport is refused as an unknown transport, not as the unsupported one

mutations.name: C23-unknown-settings
mutations.what: a misspelt setting is ignored

patches.old: for (const key of Object.keys(raw)) if (!keys.has(key)) throw
patches.new: for (const key of Object.keys(raw)) if (false) throw

mutations.name: C24-cycle
mutations.what: a cycle of env references is not detected

mutations.name: C25-missing-pass-through
mutations.what: passing on a variable the Hub does not have gives an empty value

mutations.name: C26-pass-through-not-secret
mutations.what: what a credential-looking name passes on is not known to the masker

patches.old: for (const name of raw.keys()) if (SECRET_ENV_NAME.test(name)) secret.add(name);

mutations.name: C27-plain-http-anywhere
mutations.what: plain http to any host is accepted

mutations.name: C28-shutdown-leaves-servers
mutations.what: HubManager.shutdown() does not close the MCP servers

mutations.name: C29-state-without-mcp
mutations.what: the Hub state does not report the MCP manager

mutations.name: C30-header-short-list-only
mutations.what: a credential header outside the short list (PRIVATE-TOKEN, X-Goog-Api-Key ...) is stored in plain text (audit F1)

mutations.name: C31-url-password-plain
mutations.what: a URL with a password is stored in plain text (audit F2)

mutations.name: C32-url-reference-counted
mutations.what: a URL whose password is a reference is taken for one with a password

mutations.name: C33-double-underscore-id
mutations.what: an id with "__" or a trailing "_" is accepted, so mcp__<server>__<tool> parses two ways (audit F3)

mutations.name: C34-connect-header-short-list
mutations.what: at connect time only the short list of headers is registered with the masker

mutations.name: C35-expanded-url-not-secret
mutations.what: a URL that has a password once its references are expanded is not registered

patches.old: for (const name of raw.keys()) if (URL_WITH_PASSWORD.test(values.get(name))) secret.add(name);

mutations.name: C36-url-password-alone-not-registered
mutations.what: the password of a URL is not registered on its own

patches.old: for (const value of [...secrets]) { const password = urlPassword(value); if (password && password.length >= 4) secrets.add(password); }
